rows.title: SNAP State Options Report
rows.support: Common state policy-option and administration baseline across the frozen fifty-state universe.
rows.limitations: Does not establish complete state manuals, implementation, sanctions, appeals, outcomes, or remedy effectiveness.

rows.title: SNAP Employment and Training State Plans
rows.support: Annual official route to each state's SNAP E&T plan and program design.
rows.limitations: A state plan route is not an operative caseworker screening procedure or observed implementation.

rows.title: SNAP E&T Screening and Referral Guidance
rows.support: Common federal screening and referral guidance against which state-specific procedure can be tested.
rows.limitations: Federal guidance does not prove state execution or state-specific verification practice.

rows.title: Characteristics of SNAP Households
rows.support: Official state-level SNAP household characteristics and lawful aggregate demographic data.
rows.limitations: Program characteristics do not establish subgroup effects, causal outcomes, or a complete lawful demographic breakdown.

rows.title: Final Evaluation of the SNAP Employment and Training Pilots
rows.support: Measured employment, earnings, SNAP participation, and food-security outcomes for ten state pilots.
rows.limitations: Pilot findings are bounded to the evaluated interventions and populations and do not rank entire state systems.

rows.title: Rapid Cycle Evaluation of SNAP Employment and Training
rows.support: Measured state-specific implementation and participant outcomes in five states in the frozen universe.
rows.limitations: Rapid-cycle tests are intervention-specific and do not establish statewide remedy effectiveness.

rows.title: The Use of Supervised Job Search, Job Search Training, and Integrated Job Search in USDA SNAP E&T: Three Case Studies
rows.support: State-specific process and participant-outcome findings for Connecticut, Oregon, and Tennessee.
rows.limitations: Case-study findings are not a statewide causal estimate or a national prevalence result.

rows.title: CalFresh Work and Community Engagement Requirements
rows.support: Current 2026 work rules, exemptions, waived counties, notices, and pre-screening route.
rows.limitations: Rule publication does not establish sanction counts, reversal rates, or effective correction.

rows.title: Eligibility and Assistance Standards Manual
rows.support: Operative manual chapters with dated updates through July 2026.
rows.limitations: Manual availability does not prove uniform application.

rows.title: Eligibility and Assistance Standards Manual Letters
rows.limitations: Revision custody is not an outcome measure.

rows.title: Frequently Asked Questions: State Hearings and Aid Pending
rows.support: Notice, hearing request, conditional aid pending, rehearing, judicial review, and compliance routes.
rows.limitations: Does not provide case-level reversal rates or prove timely complete restoration.

rows.title: CalFresh Food Stamp Manual, Division 63
rows.limitations: Rule publication does not establish restoration timing or complete relief.

rows.title: Able-Bodied Adults Without Dependents: General Work Requirements
Verification of Other Eligibility Factors
rows.limitations: Procedure availability does not establish consistent execution.
